clues.title: Plate: yellow front and back
text: Namibia primarily uses yellow front and back licence plates. Vanity plates are white, with blue lettering.
NOTE: Botswana and Namibia are the only countries in southern Africa where yellow rear plates are predominantly found.

images.caption: Namibian plates: regular yellow and vanity white

clues.summary: Mostly yellow plates front and back. Vanity plates are white with blue letters. Only Botswana and this country mainly have yellow rear plates in southern Africa.

clues.title: Driving side: left
text: Namibia drives on the **left side** of the road.
NOTE: This is also true for other countries in southern and eastern Africa. However all Middle Eastern countries with coverage drive on the right side.

images.caption: White pickup seen from above on a two-lane road; the warning icon at top left shows two-way traffic

clues.summary: Traffic drives on the left, like other southern and eastern African countries. All Middle Eastern countries with coverage drive on the right.

clues.title: Google car: white pickup, short antenna leaning left
text: All the coverage in Namibia was taken with a white pickup truck with a short antenna on the front. Notably, this antenna will always lean slightly to the left.

NOTE: No other country in southern Africa has a similar car. The most similar country with this type of car is Oman, however the antenna there will never lean left, but often clearly [to the right](https://maps.app.goo.gl/bwxUiVzL65G2i3d77).

images.caption: Red circle marks the short antenna leaning left on the white pickup

clues.summary: A white pickup with a short antenna on the front that always leans slightly left. No other southern African country has this car. Oman has a similar one, but its antenna never leans left and often leans right.

differs.how: antenna never leans left, often leans right

clues.title: Road lines: yellow edge, white centre
text: Most roads in Namibia use single **yellow outer lines **and white centre lines.
NOTE: The other southern African countries also use single yellow outer lines.
clues.summary: Most roads have single yellow edge lines and white centre lines. Other southern African countries also use single yellow edge lines.

clues.title: Sign: green direction signs, yellow road number
text: Namibia uses **green** directional signs with the road number in yellow.
NOTE: Green directional signs with yellow road numbers are also used in South Africa and the other Southern African countries.
- Namibia uses A, B, C, D, M, and sometimes F-roads.
- South Africa uses N and R-roads.
clues.summary: Green direction signs with the road number in yellow, as in South Africa and neighbours. Roads are A, B, C, D, M and sometimes F. South Africa uses N and R roads.

differs.how: South Africa uses N and R road letters

clues.title: Houses: German-style old buildings, German place names
text: Namibia used to be a German colony, and as such, you can still notice the German influence, most notably in their place names. Some older buildings can have a German style as well.
clues.summary: A former German colony, so place names and some older buildings still look German.

clues.title: Bollard: small stone bollards
text: You can spot these **small stone bollards** at intersections and on the sides of roads.
clues.summary: Small stone bollards at junctions and along roads.

clues.title: Bins: round metal, green and white
text: Round metal bins, often painted green and white like the Nigerian flag, can be spotted at many rest stops and intersections.
NOTE: On some roads, the bins are blue and white.
clues.summary: Round metal bins, often painted green and white, at many rest stops and junctions. On some roads they are blue and white.

clues.title: Coverage: mostly main roads only
text: The coverage in Namibia is mostly limited to main roads, with only sparse coverage on minor roads.
clues.summary: Coverage is mostly on main roads, with only sparse minor roads.

clues.title: Google car: where the car is blurred
text: Knowing where the Google car is blurred, will help narrow down your options significantly. Below are some useful use cases:
- In the north, the blurred car is only northwest of [Ondangwa](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3ket3j3jLiuT1ySR7).
- The blurred car on an unpaved road likely places you on one of many [sideroads](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YjAFjGq1fFnfehcR7) of the B1 or other major roads, or in a town.
- The paved [road](https://maps.app.goo.gl/XAwT2QndeUVDCXQZ7) between Nordoewer and Aussenkehr has the car unblurred.

- Other notable paved roads not north of Windhoek include the [C20](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YbHyk9drxFNRG9Z66), [C22 ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nwf92i6mjCV5vtJr8)(south of Gobabis), [C23](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Kz9nib6UPgXAL5oz7).
NOTE: The blurred car strongly correlates with a 2024 copyright. Use with caution.
clues.summary: Whether the Google car is blurred narrows things down. In the north the blurred car is only northwest of Ondangwa. The blurred car on dirt roads suggests side roads. A blurred car often means 2024 coverage, so use with caution.

clues.title: Route marker: D-road first digit shows region
text: D-roads are grouped into four regions based on their **first digit**.

Three-digit road numbers (e.g. [D203](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HJnq9L8fJT87JCJB6)) are found in the far south. As you move further north, you will encounter four-digit numbers beginning with 1, 2 and finally 3.
clues.summary: D-roads fall into four regions by their first digit. Three-digit numbers (like D203) are in the far south, and further north you get four-digit numbers starting with 1, 2, then 3.

clues.title: Plants: tall lush trees both sides of the road
text: Roads surrounded by** tall and lush trees** on both sides will generally place you in the north of the country. The more trees and the greener they are, the further north-northeast you should click.
clues.summary: Roads with tall, lush trees on both sides are in the north. The greener and denser, the further north-northeast you should click.

clues.title: Landscape: farmland, very light sandy soil, fan palms
text: A pocket around Oshakati, and to a lesser extent the rest of the north features more **agricultural land** and has very light sandy soil. This map also closely lines up with where you can find the [Hyphaene ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VFNb81hmYCpw6gNY8)[Petersiana ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VFNb81hmYCpw6gNY8)[fan palms](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VFNb81hmYCpw6gNY8).
clues.summary: In the north, mostly around Oshakati, there is more farmland and very light sandy soil. It lines up with where Hyphaene fan palms grow.

clues.title: Landscape: flat, dry, reddish soil, acacias
text: The landscape east of Windhoek closely resembles that of Botswana, with a generally **flat and dry** landscape, featuring** **slightly reddish soil, short **golden grass** and shrubbery, as well as acacia trees.
clues.summary: East of Windhoek the land is flat and dry with slightly reddish soil, short golden grass, shrubs and acacia trees, much like Botswana.

clues.title: Landscape: dry mountains and hills in west and south
text: Dry mountains and hills dominate much of the western and southern parts of the country.
clues.summary: Dry mountains and hills cover much of the west and south.

clues.title: Landscape: greener hills with shrubs and trees
text: Further northwest, you’ll find a somewhat greener region, where the mountains and hills will be covered in shrubbery and trees.
clues.summary: In the northwest the land is somewhat greener, with hills covered in shrubs and trees.

clues.title: Coverage: fully green grass and mountains
text: This pocket south of Tsumeb features the most lush coverage in Namibia, with the grass and mountains being completely green in colour.
clues.summary: A pocket south of Tsumeb has the most lush coverage in the country, with completely green grass and mountains.

clues.title: Landscape: dry rolling hills, yellow grass
text: Around Windhoek, you’ll find a small region with a somewhat **dry rolling hills landscape**, with hills that are covered in dry yellow grass and dead-looking bushes and small trees.
clues.summary: Around Windhoek, a small area of dry rolling hills with yellow grass and dead-looking bushes and small trees.

clues.title: Landscape: sandy coast with dunes
text: A coastal sandy landscape with the occasional sand dunes can be found around and north of Swakopmund, as well as two small pockets around Luderitz and Oranjemund further south.
clues.summary: Sandy coastal land with a few dunes around and north of Swakopmund, plus two small pockets near Luderitz and Oranjemund in the south.

clues.title: Landscape: red sandy ridges, rollercoaster roads
text: The southeast part of Namibia has countless small ridges that are NW to SE in orientation. Roads [‘riding’](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jsk2o2cmYARgmVAY7) these red sandy ridges appear bumpy, almost like a rollercoaster. Roads [winding between the](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SN2Vcep8NbA69Cxd8)[ ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SN2Vcep8NbA69Cxd8)[ridges](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SN2Vcep8NbA69Cxd8) make them appear like miniature valleys.
clues.summary: The southeast has countless small red sandy ridges running NW to SE. Roads that ride the ridges feel bumpy like a rollercoaster.

clues.title: Landscape: tall pink sand dunes
text: Tall **pink sand dunes** are mainly found just east of Sossusvlei, and can also be seen from further away on a few roads.
clues.summary: Tall pink dunes are mainly just east of Sossusvlei and can be seen from afar on a few roads.

clues.title: Plants: vineyards
text: Vineyards are exclusively found around Aussenkehr on the South African border in the south.
clues.summary: Vineyards only grow around Aussenkehr on the South African border in the south.

clues.title: Landscape: tricky farm fields
text: These somewhat baity agricultural fields can be found just west of Mariental.
clues.summary: Somewhat baity agricultural fields just west of Mariental.

clues.title: Road: divided road in savannah
text: Road A1 between Windhoek and Okahandja, featuring a savannah-like landscape, is just one of two major roads that are **divided** in Namibia. The [other one](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VVjMKLWS9dDQ2qLb8) can be found just southeast of Swakopmund, and features a dry coastal landscape, with light sandy soil and sand dunes.
clues.summary: Road A1 between Windhoek and Okahandja runs through savannah and is one of only two divided major roads. The other is near Swakopmund, in dry coastal land with light sandy soil and dunes.

clues.title: Road: empty paved road through desert
text: Road B1 south of Grunau is a desolate paved road going generally N-NE through a desert landscape with only very low and dry vegetation.
clues.summary: Road B1 south of Grunau is a lonely paved road going north-northeast through desert with only very low dry plants.

clues.title: Road lines: missing yellow edge lines on B1 stretches
text: Outer yellow road lines are missing on the following sections of the B1:
- Between Grunau and Keetmanshoop, the landscape becomes hillier, and the road quality deteriorates in general.
- This [small section](https://maps.app.goo.gl/enThcbiWS4e37Xx19) north of Keetmanshoop is cloudy.
- The [third section](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YS14ugmHJm9DeBqx5) is between Gibeon and Mariental, which is flat, and goes in a N-NE direction.
clues.summary: Yellow edge lines are missing on parts of the B1: between Grunau and Keetmanshoop (hillier, rougher road), a cloudy bit north of Keetmanshoop, and a flat north-northeast stretch between Gibeon and Mariental.

clues.title: Road: wide shoulders, excellent pavement
text: Between Gibeon and Tses, the road has wider shoulders, and the pavement quality in general is excellent.
clues.summary: The B1 between Gibeon and Tses has wider shoulders and excellent pavement.

clues.title: Road: paved arid steppe, NW road angle
text: The section of road B1 between Mariental and Rehoboth can be recognised by a combination of the generic **arid steppe landscape**, the **paved road**, and mainly the distinct** NW bound road angle**. It can also help to know that the sun is in the SE for this section.
clues.summary: B1 between Mariental and Rehoboth: arid steppe, paved road and especially a northwest road angle, with the sun in the southeast.

clues.title: Landscape: more plants, pointed lone hills
text: Around Rehoboth the landscape gradually becomes more vegetated, and as you get closer to Windhoek, the hills become more prominent, with a lot of somewhat pointed lonestanding hills, as well as ridges being visible. The weather is fairly clear with small clouds across the sky.
clues.summary: Around Rehoboth the land gets greener, and towards Windhoek hills become more prominent, with pointed lone hills and ridges. Weather is clear with small clouds.

clues.title: Road: northbound, flat, golden grass, acacias
text: North of Okahandja, the B1 follows a general northbound direction, with the sun shining brightly to the N-NW. The sky is otherwise clear of clouds. As for the landscape, it’s flatter than around Windhoek, with only the occasional hill or mountain, otherwise the short golden grass, somewhat green acacia trees and shrubbery further away from the road is typical for middle to north Namibia.
South of Sukses, you’ll see these two pointy [mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TDSJUQXQbwBwL9CNA), one of which has a sharper peak than the other, to the west of the road.
clues.summary: North of Okahandja, the B1 heads north with bright sun to the north-northwest and clear sky. It is flatter, with golden grass and green acacias. South of Sukses two pointy mountains lie west of the road.

clues.title: Road: sandy soil, ridge to the east
text: You can recognise the B2 NE of Swakopmund by the sandy soil, and the mountain ridge visible to the east. A few [lone mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/msmSb43uQCuq9SC17) or hills can be seen to the NW as well. Beware that close to Swakopmund the sky is [hazy](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HojVjgFmZKtjad7JA), and you’ll not see the ridge. On this stretch, the coastal looking sandy soil and the NE bound road angle is still generally sufficient to confirm the road.
clues.summary: The B2 northeast of Swakopmund has sandy soil, a mountain ridge to the east, and a few lone mountains northwest. Near the coast the sky is hazy.

clues.title: Coverage: sunrise with thin clouds
text: A bit further east, between Karibib and Usakos, you’ll find sunrise coverage combined with a sky covered in fairly thin clouds. There are mountains to the north, as well as smaller hills just south of the road, while it's mostly flat to the E-NE.
clues.summary: Between Karibib and Usakos, sunrise coverage with thin cloud, mountains to the north, small hills south of the road and flat land east-northeast.

clues.title: Road: clear weather, wide shoulder lines, ENE angle
text: East of Karibib, the weather becomes completely clear, and the mountains are only visible further in the distance. The wide shoulder lines combined with the E-NE road angle makes this section distinct.
clues.summary: East of Karibib the weather is completely clear, mountains are far off, and the wide shoulder lines and ENE road angle stand out.

clues.title: Road: empty paved east-southeast road
text: This desolate paved road goes in a general E-SE direction through a fairly flat and dry landscape. Small clouds dot the sky. The shrubbery is quite green for the most part, especially in the [east](https://maps.app.goo.gl/J4HCC4RMMBLLk4659), which is also very hilly.
NOTE: The easiest way to tell it apart from parts of the B4 is the eastwards driving direction on this road, as opposed to westwards on the B4.
clues.summary: A lonely paved road heading east-southeast through flat, dry land with small clouds. Shrubs are quite green, especially in the hilly east. It differs from parts of the B4 by driving east rather than west.

clues.title: Road: blindingly bright sandy soil, railway south
text: The B4 east of Luderitz has almost blindingly **bright sandy soil**. The landscape close to the road is generally flat, with hills and mountains in the distance. Close to Luderitz the landscape becomes [much hillier](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UACZ8efgUyMThsrF9). A railway follows the road closely on the south side for most of this section.
clues.summary: The B4 east of Luderitz has very bright sandy soil, flat near the road with hills in the distance, and a railway along the south side. Near the coast it gets much hillier.

clues.title: Road: winding between table-topped mountains
text: East of Aus, the road winds through some table-topped mountains, with the railway still just to the south. A [similar landscape](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TLHJpZNGFNWbJBDB7) can briefly be found further east on the road, just east of the intersection with the D432, however the mountains are bigger, closer to the road and redder in colour.
clues.summary: East of Aus the road winds through table-topped mountains with the railway to the south. A similar view east of the D432 junction has bigger, closer, redder mountains.

clues.title: Road: flat plateau, gentle incline, red soil
text: After the road climbs onto the plateau east of Kuibis, the landscape will seem mostly flat until you reach the [intersection with the D432](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LnyJcQw9FVFwQbiRA), but you can notice the road having a [gradual incline](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uKxxvnhYT7HLAqBk7) for long stretches. The soil around is very red in colour, with limited shrubbery or signs of life. The weather is clear, with some clouds far in the distance.
clues.summary: After the road climbs onto the plateau east of Kuibis it looks flat until the D432 junction, but climbs gradually for long stretches. Soil is very red, with clear weather and distant clouds.

clues.title: Road: flat with mountains close, long tabletop ridge
text: Between Seeheim and Keetmanshoop, the landscape close to the road is flat, with mountains always close by. Just east of Seeheim, you’ll see a [short ridge](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gzgznEv2KFa2Gsr29) to the NE, with a lone mountain just west of it, as well as a [long ridge](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Vy4TJZ6S5giURVcYA) far away to the west. A bit east, on the NE-bound stretch, mountains are in all directions, but you’ll see a [long uneven tabletop ridge](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4rz1mXGEGvJXA45k8) to the west. A railroad can also be seen to the south on this stretch.
clues.summary: Between Seeheim and Keetmanshoop the land is flat with mountains always nearby: a short ridge and lone mountain northeast just east of Seeheim, a long tabletop ridge west, and a railway to the south.

clues.title: Road: eastward, orange soil, always cloudy
text: Road B6 goes in a general eastwards direction from Windhoek, with the landscape ranging from [hilly](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HKH2ANTv77TFfAKp8) close to Windhoek, to [mostly flat](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LPHBgkFuNUibVNjm8) closer to Gobabis. The soil is somewhat orange in colour, with short green grass and otherwise green vegetation growing from it. The cloud cover also varies, but no part of this road has a clear sky.
NOTE: The only other similar paved road, road [C39](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gtHvwZTt24sAB3wa8), has brighter soil.
clues.summary: Road B6 heads east from Windhoek, hilly near the city and flatter near Gobabis. Soil is orange with short green grass, and the sky is never clear. The C39 is similar but has brighter soil.

clues.title: Road: light grainy pavement, ENE, green north
text: You can recognise this long stretch of B8 by the **light coloured grainy pavement** as well as the general E-NE angle and vegetated northern landscape.
clues.summary: A long stretch of the B8 has light, grainy pavement, an east-northeast angle and a green, wooded northern landscape.

clues.title: Road: bright soil, clear sky, clouds over ridge
text: Bright soil, clear skies with cloud cover to the east over a tabletop mountain ridge makes this paved N-NW bound road distinct.
clues.summary: A paved road heading north-northwest with bright soil, clear skies and cloud over a tabletop ridge to the east.

clues.title: Road: unpaved, cloudy sky, clears in south
text: The C14 bears resemblance to the previous road, except this road is unpaved, and the skies are covered in a blanket of clouds, especially in the northern half. Near the [southern end](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aJvPPxGcTbmq5hnB7), the sky becomes clear.
NOTE: The [stretch](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HGx8m6SKyVvh5ngH9) south of Bethanien is paved.
clues.summary: The C14 is like the previous road but unpaved, with a blanket of cloud especially in the north, and a clear sky near the south end.

clues.title: Road: very red soil, golden grass tufts, dark clouds
text: Very red soil and small tufts of golden grass lining the road can be used to recognise the paved C19. The sky is mostly covered in [dark clouds](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uvykRJGr5JqN4sXd7), especially to the north.
clues.summary: The paved C19 has very red soil, small tufts of golden grass beside the road and a mostly dark cloudy sky, especially in the north.

clues.title: Road: paved east, orange grass, rocky hills hug road
text: The C22 is a paved road generally going east, with freshly cut, orange tufts of grass along the road. A couple of [large, rocky hills](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ftYtR38mWBSMU9Gs6) almost hug the road near the middle. The blinding sun low on the horizon to the east can also be helpful.

NOTE: A short stretch near Okakarara was taken at a different time, making it less distinct. Look for the low [ridge](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kXwRLyf95Tyfq6sR6) N-NW and the [sun](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LkeSTV4Wi2U1BpkB6) to the NNE to confirm.
clues.summary: The paved C22 heads east with freshly cut orange grass and large rocky hills hugging the road near the middle, with a blinding low sun to the east. A short stretch near Okakarara was filmed at another time.

clues.title: Landscape: rugged mountains west of paved road
text: A large rugged mountain formation can be seen to the west from the paved C13. Other smaller hills and mountains can be seen in other directions. Light coloured soil hugs the road, while more orange coloured soil can be seen further from the road, with light green vegetation and shrubbery acting as a contrast.
Another easy way to get the road is to look for the [wispy clouds trying to hide the sun](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PrvocmJ5bXzvv823A) in the east.
clues.summary: From the paved C13 a large rugged mountain formation shows to the west. Soil is light by the road and orange further away, with light green plants. Wispy clouds hiding the sun in the east also help.

clues.title: Bollard: white, two yellow reflectors, black sand
text: The C34 looks like darker streaks of black sand surrounded by more sand as far as the eye can see. Some coastal shrubbery, and even the [coast](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iYzuJD2UtEKEzAh27) can be seen in some parts. [Unique white bollards](https://maps.app.goo.gl/A9USD6ywaLZWggcN8) with two yellow reflectors on the front, and one red in the back can also be seen along the road at regular intervals.

images.caption: White bollard circled in red at the left edge of a sandy gravel road

clues.summary: The C34 looks like darker streaks of black sand in more sand, sometimes with coastal shrubs or the coast. Unique white bollards with two yellow reflectors on the front stand along the road.

clues.title: Road: red grainy pavement, green grass, low clouds
text: Red tinted and slightly grainy pavement along with the green savannah-like grassy landscape crowned with [low-lying cumulus clouds](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sThNdCyePnA6XouS9) can be used to recognise the northern section of road C35.
clues.summary: The northern part of the C35 has red-tinted grainy pavement, green savannah-like grass and low cumulus clouds.

clues.title: Road: loses red pavement, sandy, SSE angle
text: South of the C41 intersection, the road loses its red pavement, and the quality worsens. The landscape is less grassy, and more sandy, with [hills](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HByXtaekqiaUQGk77) to the west, though often hidden behind the vegetation. The road generally goes in a S-SE direction. Further south, it gets hillier, and parts will have a more SE bound angle. The sky is consistently covered by scattered [cirrostratus](https://maps.app.goo.gl/K6hbEGCHVQJKwN58A) and [cumulus](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d26SpmrumkcZVnv36) clouds.
clues.summary: South of the C41 junction the road loses its red pavement and gets worse. Land is sandier with hills to the west, usually heading south-southeast, with scattered cloud. Further south it gets hillier.

clues.title: Coverage: dramatic clouds and orange horizon
text: A short section NW of Kamanjab along with the same somewhat green and hilly landscape, features an impressive array of clouds in the sky, with the sun attempting to peek out from the west. [Hues of orange](https://maps.app.goo.gl/u7ykwqpSUqGCP8up6) can be seen on the horizon.
clues.summary: A short stretch northwest of Kamanjab in green hilly land with lots of clouds, the sun peeking from the west and orange hues on the horizon.

clues.title: Landscape: very rugged mountains to the west
text: A very rugged mountain formation can be seen to the west from a few sections of the C35 and its sideroads.
clues.summary: A very rugged mountain formation is visible to the west from a few sections of the C35 and its side roads.

clues.title: Road: sandy soil, green plants, spotty clouds
text: The C38 is yet another indistinct paved northern road with sandy soil, somewhat green vegetation and short grass lining the road. The sky, which is covered with a spotty blanket of clouds, is generally the most distinct clue. The [sun](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SY2Uwe1FJgutDk4QA) is faintly shining through the clouds to the north.
clues.summary: The C38 is an ordinary paved northern road with sandy soil, short grass and a spotty blanket of cloud, with the sun faintly visible to the north.

clues.title: Landscape: wide valley with small green hills
text: Most of the C39 travels through a wide valley, with small vegetation-covered hills on both sides, which are mostly visible to the [north](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Z4Efxbhd9wpBQ5AR7). The N-NE angle and puffy cumulus clouds dotting the sunny sky are also noteworthy.
clues.summary: The C39 runs through a wide valley with small green hills on both sides, mostly to the north, heading north-northeast with puffy clouds in a sunny sky.

clues.title: Road: flat NW road with cumulus clouds
text: The C40 has a general NW angle going through flat terrain with the usual northern landscape of short grass next to the road, trees further away and some hills further in the distance. Similar to the C39, a lot of cumulus clouds dot the sky, and the closer to Kamanjab you get, the lower the [sun](https://maps.app.goo.gl/P3hJec6yLcs49L6SA) sets to the west.
clues.summary: The C40 heads northwest through flat land with short grass, trees further off, hills in the distance and lots of cumulus clouds. Closer to Kamanjab the sun sits lower in the west.

clues.title: Road: grainy pavement, soft grass, cumulus clouds
text: East of the intersection with the C35, the road has a constant SW to NW angle, and grainy pavement. The grass looks soft to the touch, and the somewhat sandy soil is typical of this region. Cumulus clouds dot the sky.
[West of the C35 intersection](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9jXSgyXW1W6ZBLUL7), the same grainy pavement and clouds remain, but the landscape is much hillier, and the road angle changes.
clues.summary: East of the C35 junction the road has a constant SW to NW angle and grainy pavement, with soft-looking grass, sandy soil and cumulus clouds. West of the junction the pavement and clouds stay but the land is hillier.

clues.title: Road: red tabletop mountains, wide gravel road
text: Along the C43 you can find some of the most impressive [red-coloured tabletop mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/q2ML2FED7ajJFLbb7). The road is wide and unpaved with light coloured gravel contrasting the otherwise red landscape.
clues.summary: The C43 passes some of the most impressive red tabletop mountains, on a wide unpaved road of light gravel against the red land.

clues.title: Road: wide unpaved sandy road lined with trees
text: The C44 is a** wide unpaved sandy road** lined with trees, easily recognised from the general E-SE angle, and the **westbound driving direction**.
NOTE: The [D3301](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wdf7hyQBdEfnhgXr8), a bit further south looks similar, but the soil is generally much redder, and the car is driving east.
clues.summary: The C44 is a wide unpaved sandy road lined with trees, heading east-southeast with westbound driving. The D3301 looks similar but has redder soil and the car drives east.

clues.title: Road: even wider unpaved road, redder soil
text: The C47 is an **even wider unpaved road**, with slightly** redder soil** when compared to the C44. The road angle on this road is NE bound, with a SW driving direction. You can also look for either a [clear sky](https://maps.app.goo.gl/x2NHYCZsMCs2hKNz7), or [wispy clouds](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cdo4jnSLg1kDQJoz9).
clues.summary: The C47 is wider than the C44 and has slightly redder soil. It heads northeast with the car driving southwest, under clear or wispy-cloud skies.

clues.title: Road lines: poor pavement, faded or no lines
text: Often fairly **poor quality pavement** with [only white road lines](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Jf6P3gTK1pfE144b9), [no road lines at all](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RNMAWUQFhJFheYrK6), or just slightly [faded road lines and red tinted pavement](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JyFSRjp81cNB64Wz6), are all good clues for the C49 in the panhandle. Near the western end, the [sun](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tGh9NAzuqvDdPpjF7) is very low in the sky, and the weather is fully clear.
NOTE: A [small section](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vvEApEqhL8fBQX6G6) by Makolonga has good pavement with wide shoulders, so look for the orange patches on the road.
clues.summary: The C49 in the narrow northeastern strip often has poor pavement with only white lines, no lines, or faded lines on red-tinted pavement. A small section near Makolonga has good pavement and wide shoulders.

clues.title: Road: light grainy pavement, very faded yellow lines
text: The D3600 and the [unlabelled road](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RTqENPBLvJo7fsBd6) going NE to Mpungu, have a very light coloured, sometimes grainy pavement, with at times [very faded yellow lines](https://maps.app.goo.gl/X3ZNNmiVtCtcwsiC9), which are hard to even see. Combined with the either exactly N to S or NE angle, as well as the northern landscape, make this road very distinct.
clues.summary: The D3600 and the unlabelled road northeast to Mpungu have light, sometimes grainy pavement and very faded yellow lines, running exactly north-south or northeast.

clues.title: Road lines: northern roads without yellow edges
text: A few roads in the north lack the typical outer yellows.

- The [C46](https://maps.app.goo.gl/A2iuCsBL27yXdx5L8), which is a long road going generally NW to SE. The [E-W section by Ruacana](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TkmT5fLgDYyqJGRC7), has very poor pavement. [SE of Oshikuku](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8ETt6hv4choo1q9B6), the sun is low in the sky to the NW.
- [C41 (M123)](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oe2n4NQt2GrYct8G6) also has a NW angle but has more clouds in the sky than the C46.
- [B10](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pj18CXj2apN1rFNF9) west of Eenhana is an E-W stretch, which is more vegetated, and also has the sun low in the sky to the west.

- [B10](https://maps.app.goo.gl/t2rL31dKFVdiAHhs7) east of Nkurenkuru is another NW bound stretch with the sun low in the sky, but this part is much more vegetated than the C46. You can also see the [moon](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DSwUn3Fn5S9pfiVW7) to the east.
- [D3615](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Xk6TXPZPYkXYuShh7) is a short road with a constant N-NE angle that technically has outer yellows, but they are quite faded.
clues.summary: A few northern roads lack yellow edge lines: the C46 (northwest to southeast, with very poor pavement in the east-west part), part of the B10 west of Eenhana, and another part east of Nkurenkuru. The D3615 has very faded yellow ones.

clues.title: City: tall buildings, gated houses, white street signs
text: Windhoek is by far the largest city in Namibia, as well as the richest, with many [high rise buildings](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2FUr1J4JEF7QN7D96) near downtown. Affluent and often gated single family houses are a common sight on the sides of hilly streets, which are often well marked with simple white street signs.
In the northwest of the city you’ll find the [slums ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SfddeDfHCm1tL2Ds6)dotting the hills.
clues.summary: By far the largest and richest city, with high-rises downtown, affluent gated houses on hilly streets with simple white street signs, and slums on hills to the northwest.

clues.title: City: north-south grid in red desert, blue bins
text: Gobabis is a big** north-south gridded** city in the desert, with** red soil** permeating the landscape and roads, which are very often unpaved. A faint green ridge is sometimes visible to the north to northwest. The [street signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yc9JLDVMMF9166Go7), while rare, are also green, with silver framing on the top and bottom. [Blue bins](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nEKjHa3Md6L2VEtr8) are also a good clue for Gobabis.
clues.summary: A large north-south grid city in the desert with red soil, many unpaved roads, and a faint green ridge to the north-northwest. Street signs are rare and green with silver framing. Blue bins are a clue.

clues.title: City: flat coast town, sandy streets, palms
text: The coastal cities of Swakopmund and Walvis Bay are **flat **and often have** sandy streets**, with **palms** and Norfolk pines planted around. Street and road signs often have [square-shaped signposts](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wrtSH3P4gsmkEgXy6).
Road angles can be used to line up parts of the city, but a northeast bound angle is common in both.
These [white and blue plastic containers](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tqK6dNW6hqXnVhBR9) are common in Swakopmund, as are [yellow lamp posts](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8DgByYnCTwNfJgTG7) in downtown areas.
clues.summary: The two coastal cities are flat with sandy streets, palms and Norfolk pines, and square signposts. White and blue plastic containers are common, and yellow lamp posts downtown.

clues.title: Town: poorer coast town, mostly unpaved
text: While very similar to Swakopmund and Walvis Bay, Henties Bay is less gridded and noticeably poorer, with most roads being unpaved. Unlike in Swakopmund, where yellow lamps are only found near the downtown, here they can occasionally be found throughout the town.
The cloudy weather can be used to confirm the town.
clues.summary: Like the bigger coastal towns, but less gridded and poorer, with mostly unpaved roads. Yellow lamps appear throughout, not just downtown. Cloudy weather confirms it.

clues.title: Town: pink brick sidewalks, always overcast
text: Langstrand is a small resort town between Swakopmund and Walvis Bay with **pink brick sidewalks** next to essentially every road. The weather is always **overcast **and gloomy.
clues.summary: A small resort town between two coastal cities with pink brick sidewalks along nearly every road. Weather is always overcast and gloomy.

clues.title: Town: light rocky hillsides everywhere
text: **Light coloured rocky hillsides** are everywhere in the hilly coastal town of Luderitz.
clues.summary: Light-coloured rocky hillsides are everywhere in the hilly coastal town of Luderitz.

clues.title: Town: gridded, lots of planted trees, Norfolk pines
text: Oranjemund is a well-off gridded city with almost exactly east to west streets, with an abundance of** planted vegetation** all around the city. Multiple [Norfolk pines](https://maps.app.goo.gl/P3Su4Jd2vpxZqgDCA) can be seen almost everywhere. Streets are well organised with E-W avenues and N-S streets, which can be seen written on [small blue markers](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3pZrSDpLRb4ZCa5E6) next to the gates or on [street signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zQgR2ugtF3LkBsoZ7), which have varying designs.
clues.summary: A well-off gridded town with almost exactly east-west streets and many planted trees, including Norfolk pines. Streets are E-W avenues and N-S streets, written on small blue markers by gates or on street signs.

clues.title: Town: orange thatched fences and huts on a slope
text: Orange coloured **thatched fences**, **walls**, and **huts **are everywhere in the desert town of Aussenkehr, which is built on the [slope](https://maps.app.goo.gl/h6kpwafSqasy6Q7k6) of a hill.
clues.summary: Orange thatched fences, walls and huts are everywhere in the desert town of Aussenkehr, built on a hill slope.

clues.title: Town: thatched fences on flat land, cliff to SW
text: While not as common, the same thatched architecture is present in Noordoewer, and unlike Aussenkehr, the town was built on flat land, with an [imposing cliffside](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JqoV8nVjpTkh3oq89) visible to the southwest, across the border in South Africa. Similar mountains can be seen to the north as well.
clues.summary: Noordoewer has the same thatched style but is built on flat land, with an imposing cliff across the border to the southwest and similar mountains north.

differs.how: cliff visible across the border in South Africa

clues.title: Town: dry mountains northeast and southwest
text: Rosh Pinah can easily be recognised by the dry mountains just northeast of the city, as well as slightly further away to the [southwest](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3LbfPf8DFpVwr35d8).
clues.summary: Rosh Pinah is recognised by dry mountains just northeast of the town and further away to the southwest.

clues.title: Town: very rocky, bare hills all around
text: The landscape of Aus is very rocky, with dry hills devoid of vegetation all around. The hills to the north have a fairly [smooth sloped shape](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ikY4ReviAoc2v2iB9), while the peaks to the south are [more rugged](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vd5ixxRnz7hyxA6q9).
clues.summary: Aus is very rocky with dry, bare hills around. Hills to the north are smooth and sloped, peaks to the south are more rugged.

clues.title: Town: deep light sand streets with tyre tracks
text: While not entirely unique, most streets in Rundu consist of **deep** and **light coloured sand**, with a bumpy texture, and** tire tracks engraved** into it.
clues.summary: Most streets in Rundu are deep, light-coloured sand with a bumpy texture and engraved tyre tracks. Not entirely unique.

clues.title: Town: orange mountains covered in green plants
text: **Orange coloured mountains**, which are covered in** green vegetation** surround the partly hilly town of Opuwo, from where you have a [great vantage point](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WwNYhsFjQYfs1DZm9) of the mountains.
clues.summary: Opuwo is a partly hilly town surrounded by orange mountains covered in green plants, with a great viewpoint over them.

clues.title: Town: far mountains all around, NE-SW grid
text: Otavi sits in between many sets of mountains, all of which are quite far away, but can be seen from the city. Being a northern town, Otavi is quite green, with slightly reddish sandy soil, which is common for the more northern cities. The entire town is on a northeast to southwest grid, which can rule out similar looking cities like [Grootfontein](https://maps.app.goo.gl/voT4iBmdxMiajBws8) and [Tsumeb](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7M38actJN9NSjZuz8).
clues.summary: Otavi lies among many far-off mountains. It is green with slightly reddish sandy soil, and the whole town is on a northeast to southwest grid, which rules out similar towns like Grootfontein and Tsumeb.

clues.title: Town: dark mountain north, dry hills south
text: From almost anywhere in Karibib the dark silhouette of [Erongo Mountain](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VZT5WhPkZaDvGadR9) can be seen to the north. Dry [hills](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ix95xqTwU1d6oC1g7) covered in shrubbery flank the town to the south.
clues.summary: From almost anywhere in Karibib you see the dark silhouette of Erongo Mountain to the north, and dry shrubby hills south of town.

clues.title: Town: lone tall ridge with striated texture
text: A lone** tall ridge** with a **rugged, striated texture** lies to the SSE of Usakos. Another smaller plain textured mountain, which has a red tint to it, is just to the east, or northeast, depending on part of town. From the northern part of town, the cliffy edges of [Erongo Mountain](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DSp83gUhu7qPXGCF7) are visible to the north.
clues.summary: A lone tall ridge with a rugged striated texture lies south-southeast of Usakos, with a smaller red-tinted mountain to the east or northeast. From the north, the cliffy edges of Erongo Mountain are visible.

clues.title: Town: crown-shaped mountain, white open pit mines
text: The crown-like outline of [Mt Brandeburg](https://maps.app.goo.gl/eegoCaedE3ehW8Mp7) is barely visible to the northwest from most parts of Uis, while Many other dry hills surround the town. The [open pit mines](https://maps.app.goo.gl/W2KRgzq2Wsv83HRU8), which have a distinctive white colour, can be seen from the western half of Uis.
clues.summary: The crown-like outline of Mt Brandeberg is faintly visible northwest from most of Uis, with many dry hills around. White open pit mines show from the western half.

clues.title: Town: single flat-topped rocky hill
text: Ariamsvlei can be recognised by a single flat-topped hill with rocky ridgelines near the top, and small amounts of green shrubbery dotting the slopes. The hill is either to the north, or east, depending on the part of town. The soil has a dark red tint to it, with lots of bushes and small trees growing around the place.
clues.summary: Ariamsvlei has a single flat-topped hill with rocky ridgelines near the top and a little green shrub on the slopes, to the north or east depending on where you are. Soil is dark red with bushes and small trees.

clues.title: Phone numbers: area codes start with 06
text: Namibia area codes will always begin with 06, followed by 1 digit determining the area.
Notably, the city of Windhoek is 061

clues.summary: Area codes always begin with 06, then one digit for the area. Windhoek is 061.

clues.title: Pole: three alternating insulators on top
text: Poles with 3 alternating insulators sticking out horizontally at the top. This pole can be found everywhere in Namibia. It is a good clue for Namibia in a Kenya or Oman 50/50.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.summary: Three insulators sticking out horizontally and alternating at the top, found everywhere. A good clue for this country in a 50-50 against Kenya or Oman.

differs.how: use this pole as a tiebreaker
use this pole as a tiebreaker

clues.title: Pole: horizontal bar with insulators like birds
text: It features mostly 1 horizontal bars with thin white insulators that resemble rows of birds, which is why they are referred to as “bird poles” in the community. It is a good clue for Namibia in a Kenya or Oman 50/50.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.summary: Usually one horizontal bar with thin white insulators that look like a row of birds, so called 'bird poles'. A good clue against Kenya or Oman.

differs.how: use this pole as a tiebreaker
use this pole as a tiebreaker

clues.title: Pole: A-frame with insulators on a bar
text: Poles with 3 bars forming the letter ‘A’, with the bottom insulators being attached at the edges of a horizontal bar, can be found everywhere in Namibia. It is a good clue for Namibia in a Kenya or Oman 50/50.
